name: Hampton Inn Tropicana

sources.observed: Official images1,12,5 visually inspected: cream/terracotta exterior, green hip crowns, brick base, covered arrival; lobby with wood reception counters, ring chandelier, lounge; breakfast space with magenta wall, mustard seating and buffet. Image7 inspected: irregular pool, rock waterfall, timber lounge chairs with blue cushions and substantial palms/planting. These landscape details are not yet fully modelled. Image6 additionally inspected on 2026-10-27: rock feature is at the side of basin, courtyard framed by palms/shrubs, green-roofed rear entrance and firepit seating; present placement remains approximate.
Satellite inspected: rotated parallel wings around southwest-facing pool courtyard; northeast arrival facing Dean Martin. Source dates vary.

implemented: Original six-storey exterior fitted to mapped angled wings; framed glazing, spandrels, brick base, cornices, raised sign pavilions and green hipped arrival canopy.
Public lobby/reception and breakfast furnishings based on official photographs, with original wood/floor/textile maps and circulation kept clear.
Courtyard pool and deck with lounge seating; animated pool material integrated using existing water system.
Only152 owned shell and matching collision faces removed; retained geometry exact-equal.
Refinement: rounded seat cushions, splayed timber chair legs, reduced periodic wood/floor grain; asymmetrical pool basin, original rock feature, eight fan palms and planted boundary beds.
remaining: Accurate facade bay widths, crown profiles, sign typography and surface weathering need closer reference matching.

Courtyard remains approximate: flowing waterfall effect, naturalistic sandstone and mature foliage, striped cushions, detailed outdoor furniture, firepit and rear entrance canopy are unfinished. Rock feature now placed beside the basin; palm collision proxies removed from visible export.

Interior is a simplified photo-supported interpretation. Exact room boundaries, breakfast arches, displays, ornaments and seating profiles remain unverified or incomplete. Private hotel rooms remain closed.
Not photorealistically complete; keep active for courtyard and facade/interior refinement.
Wood/floor grain improved and soft seating rounded; remaining furniture, cabinetry, textile pattern and ornament detail still simplified.

verification.visualReview: Installed refined lobby/reception, corrected courtyard pool and arrival screenshots inspected. Grain reduced; rounded cushions and splayed chair legs added. Side rock feature replaced end pile; palm collision proxies excluded from visual export. Courtyard foliage/rock detail still visibly simplified; facade lacks exact cornice, crown and signage detail.
